name: MobileID
desc: Developed a Django/Vue identity platform for PDF417 barcode generation, profile management, and device-aware sessions backed by PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.
highlights: Implemented defense-in-depth authentication with HTTP-only cookie JWTs, CSRF validation, refresh-token rotation and blacklisting, immediate session revocation, Argon2 hashing, and scoped credential-stuffing controls.
Enforced Bandit, Safety, Trivy, and dependency-audit gates alongside Django tests with a 70% coverage threshold, Playwright E2E tests, and Docker/Vite build validation.

name: TokenRouter
desc: Engineered an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with cross-provider protocol conversion, priority/weighted routing, failure-aware retries, and concurrency-safe reservation and settlement of token quotas.
highlights: Protected relay and control planes with SSRF-safe outbound dialing, JWT refresh rotation and replay detection, Casbin RBAC, WebAuthn/TOTP, step-up verification, rate limits, and race-tested quota logic.
